When choosing apps for your child’s device, keep in mind that many are for general audiences, just like the ones that you might use yourself. General audience apps are not specifically designed or tailored for children. Your child may use them to:
 
	• Access and search the internet 
	• Send and receive email, chat messages, video and voice calls 
	• Create, view, and share content, including photos, videos, audio messages, notes, and presentations 
	• Make in-app purchases
